verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents associating errors with code versions: it shows which versions throw exceptions, and its deploy tracking unlocks debugging features. Marketing also says it "connects errors, replays, and releases in one place" and "points you to the code behind each error," so the release side of the story is covered. No evidence explicitly shows a per-issue 'first seen in release' field or suspect-commit identification. Missing for 10: explicit first-seen-release display per item, suspect-commit/commit attribution docs, details of what deploy tracking unlocks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
